milestone: COMP91 missing-left direct-CV scalar == and < warning continuations
status: bounded independent source/state review passed; comparison family remains partial
scope: Two distinct direct CVs: missing left and initially defined scalar right, which remains defined and scalar after the handler. Includes late reference creation and rebinding, primitive/string-carrier right values, false/default reporting and supplied-handler Exception cleanup.
target: PHP 8.5.10 CLI NTS64; ordinary profile; LC_ALL=C TZ=UTC
engine_basis: Zend/zend_vm_def.h::ZEND_IS_EQUAL/ZEND_IS_SMALLER fetch both raw CV pointers through GET_OP*_ZVAL_PTR_UNDEF. zend_is_equal_helper/zend_is_smaller_helper warn and freeze an UNDEF op1, then check the current op2 before zend_compare. These pointers retain current CV wrappers without identity-style early dereference.
implementation: Module 207 reuses the stable missing-left ERROR_READ_RESULT shape. A separate Equal/Smaller source mapping admits only distinct direct CVs with both compiled lines; scalar domain guards apply at entry/resume, independently of the saved source certificate. The old generic source mapping, fields, tasks, roots and module manifest are unchanged.
behavior: The missing left stays NULL after its name becomes 9. Plain right 1 to 0 makes == true and < false; right 0 to string 0 makes == false and < true.
A newly created right reference and a rebound preexisting reference follow the current cell. Old alias values survive; owners change 1 to 2 or old 2 to 1/new 2, with no borrowed old-cell owner.

False/default Warning order and supplied Exception destination 41, catch identity and finally agree exactly. Four SL groups check authentic warning dispatch/resume/comparison, whole raw states, owners, source/compiled-line refusals and zero/split budgets.
Both-missing ingress and callback-produced array right values are explicit source refusals. Coherent removed-right states retain valid source evidence but stop Unsupported without a new event.
